audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua west-Jordan allotment introduction and Caleb-Hebron claim, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Eleazar/Joshua/tribal-head allocation, lot procedure, Joseph's two tribes, Levite cities, Caleb's Kadesh memory, forty-five-year endurance, age and strength, Anakim/fortified-city claim, blessing, and Hebron/Kiriath-arba tradition.

verses.restored: These are inheritances children of Israel received in land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and heads of fathers' houses of tribes of children of Israel caused them to inherit.

familiar.text: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.

modern.text: Now these are the portions that the Israelites inherited in the land of Canaan, as distributed by Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families of the tribes of Israel.

original.text: וְאֵ֛לֶּה אֲשֶׁר נָחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִֽחֲל֜וּ אוֹתָ֗ם אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֔וּן וְרָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: By lot was their inheritance, as YHWH commanded by hand of Moses, for nine tribes and half tribe.

familiar.text: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.

modern.text: Their inheritance was assigned by lot for the nine and a half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

original.text: בְּגוֹרַ֖ל נַחֲלָתָ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּיַד מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְתִשְׁעַ֥ת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֥י הַמַּטֶּֽה

verses.restored: For Moses had given inheritance of two tribes and half tribe across Jordan, but to Levites he gave no inheritance in their midst.

familiar.text: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.

modern.text: For Moses had given the inheritance east of the Jordan to the other two and a half tribes. But he granted no inheritance among them to the Levites.

original.text: כִּֽי נָתַ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה נַחֲלַ֨ת שְׁנֵ֤י הַמַּטּוֹת֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הַמַּטֶּ֔ה מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְלַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹֽא נָתַ֥ן נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּתוֹכָֽם

verses.restored: For sons of Joseph became two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim; and they gave no portion in land to Levites except cities to dwell in, with pasturelands for their livestock and possessions.

familiar.text: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

modern.text: The descendants of Joseph became two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. And no portion of the land was given to the Levites, except for cities in which to live, along with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.

original.text: כִּֽי הָי֧וּ בְנֵֽי יוֹסֵ֛ף שְׁנֵ֥י מַטּ֖וֹת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְאֶפְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא נָתְנוּ֩ חֵ֨לֶק לַלְוִיִּ֜ם בָּאָ֗רֶץ כִּ֤י אִם עָרִים֙ לָשֶׁ֔בֶת וּמִ֨גְרְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם לְמִקְנֵיהֶ֖ם וּלְקִנְיָנָֽם

verses.restored: As YHWH commanded Moses, so children of Israel did, and they divided land.

familiar.text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

modern.text: So the Israelites did as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they divided the land. Caleb Requests Hebron

original.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיַּחְלְק֖וּ אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Sons of Judah drew near to Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, You know word YHWH spoke to Moses man of Divine concerning me and concerning you at Kadesh-barnea.

familiar.text: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.

modern.text: Then the sons of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh-barnea about you and me.

verses.restored: Forty years old was I when Moses servant of YHWH sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out land, and I returned word to him as it was with my heart.

familiar.text: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.

modern.text: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I brought back to him an honest report.

original.text: בֶּן אַרְבָּעִ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה אָנֹכִ֗י בִּ֠שְׁלֹחַ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לְרַגֵּ֣ל אֶת הָאָ֑רֶץ וָאָשֵׁ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר עִם לְבָבִֽי

verses.restored: My brothers who went up with me caused heart of people to melt, but I fully followed after YHWH my Divine.

familiar.text: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

modern.text: Although my brothers who went with me made the hearts of the people melt with fear, I remained loyal to the LORD my God.

original.text: וְאַחַי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָל֣וּ עִמִּ֔י הִמְסִ֖יו אֶת לֵ֣ב הָעָ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתִי אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי

verses.restored: Moses swore on that day, saying, Surely land upon which your foot trod shall be for you as inheritance and for your sons forever, because you fully followed after YHWH my Divine.

familiar.text: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children’s for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.

modern.text: On that day Moses swore to me, saying, ‘Surely the land on which you have set foot will be an inheritance to you and your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’

original.text: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֣ע מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִם לֹ֗א הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דָּרְכָ֤ה רַגְלְךָ֙ בָּ֔הּ לְךָ֨ תִֽהְיֶ֧ה לְנַחֲלָ֛ה וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ עַד עוֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתָ אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי

verses.restored: Now look, YHWH has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years since YHWH spoke this word to Moses while Israel walked in wilderness; and now look, today I am eighty-five years old.

familiar.text: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.

modern.text: Now behold, as the LORD promised, He has kept me alive these forty-five years since He spoke this word to Moses, while Israel wandered in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old,

original.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּה֩ הֶחֱיָ֨ה יְהוָ֣ה אוֹתִי֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּר֒ זֶה֩ אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנָ֗ה מֵ֠אָז דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֶת הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֥ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְעַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם בֶּן חָמֵ֥שׁ וּשְׁמוֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה

verses.restored: Still today I am strong as on day Moses sent me; as my strength then, so my strength now, for war and for going out and coming in.

familiar.text: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

modern.text: still as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out. As my strength was then, so it is now for war, for going out, and for coming in.

original.text: עוֹדֶ֨נִּי הַיּ֜וֹם חָזָ֗ק כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ בְּי֨וֹם שְׁלֹ֤חַ אוֹתִי֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּכֹ֥חִי אָ֖ז וּכְכֹ֣חִי עָ֑תָּה לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְלָצֵ֥את וְלָבֽוֹא

verses.restored: Now give me this hill country of which YHWH spoke on that day, for you heard on that day that Anakim were there and cities great and fortified. Perhaps YHWH will be with me, and I shall dispossess them, as YHWH spoke.

familiar.text: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

modern.text: Now therefore give me this hill country that the LORD promised me on that day, for you yourself heard then that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities. Perhaps with the LORD’s help I will drive them out, as the LORD has spoken.”

original.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה תְּנָה לִּי֙ אֶת הָהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא כִּ֣י אַתָּֽה שָׁמַעְתָּ֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא כִּֽי עֲנָקִ֣ים שָׁ֗ם וְעָרִים֙ גְּדֹל֣וֹת בְּצֻר֔וֹת אוּלַ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אוֹתִי֙ וְה֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה

original.text: וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת חֶבְר֛וֹן לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֖ה לְנַחֲלָֽה

modern.text: Therefore Hebron belongs to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite as an inheritance to this day, because he wholly followed the LORD, the God of Israel.

original.text: עַל כֵּ֣ן הָיְתָֽה חֶ֠בְרוֹן לְכָלֵ֨ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֤ה הַקְּנִזִּי֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִלֵּ֔א אַחֲרֵ֕י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Name of Hebron formerly was Kiriath-arba; Arba was a great man among Anakim. And land rested from war.

familiar.text: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.

modern.text: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba, after Arba, the greatest man among the Anakim.) Then the land had rest from war.

original.text: וְשֵׁ֨ם חֶבְר֤וֹן לְפָנִים֙ קִרְיַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע הָאָדָ֧ם הַגָּד֛וֹל בָּעֲנָקִ֖ים ה֑וּא וְהָאָ֥רֶץ שָׁקְטָ֖ה מִמִּלְחָמָֽה

translation_notes: Western allocation is shared among priestly, military-civic, and tribal leadership rather than controlled by Joshua alone.
Lot allocation expresses Divine ordering in the ancient narrative but is not an acceptable modern method for overriding inhabitants, land rights, or evidence.
Levites receive cities and pasturelands rather than a continuous tribal territory, requiring communal support without granting superior human status.
Caleb is identified as a Kenizzite within Judah, preserving a complex identity that resists simplistic ethnic purity narratives.
His memory emphasizes truthful reporting, long endurance, and a promise carried for forty-five years.
Caleb's vigor at eighty-five is celebrated as his individual experience. It must not shame elders who are frail, disabled, ill, or unable to work or fight.
His Hebron claim still entails dispossessing Anakim from fortified cities, so personal faithfulness cannot erase the violence experienced by current inhabitants.
The repeated 'land rested from war' formula remains a victor's summary and must be read beside unresolved inhabitants and future conflict.
safety_note: Do not use Joshua 14 to justify conquest, land seizure by lot, ethnic-purity claims, ageism, ableism, or the idea that faithful elders must remain physically powerful. Center shared governance, long memory, truthful witness, honored aging in all bodily conditions, and promises interpreted without erasing existing communities.
